issue.title: tests/test_models_panel_history.py: 3 tests assert footer History hint that no longer renders
issue.description: Three tests in tests/test_models_panel_history.py fail deterministically on clean master, unrelated to any in-flight diff: test_footer_shows_history_only_for_supported_rows[large-True], test_footer_shows_history_only_for_supported_rows[bucket:research-True], and test_footer_shows_history_for_alias_backed_launch_setting. All assert the models-panel footer contains an 'H'/'History' hint for history-supported rows (e.g. size aliases, research bucket, alias-backed launch settings), but the rendered footer text (e.g. 'ctrl+e=Effort  ctrl+r=Limit  p=Providers / o=Override  ...=Clear  e=Edit  r=Reset  j/k=Navigate  '=Jump  esc=Close') no longer contains it. Reproduction: .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_models_panel_history.py -k 'test_footer_shows_history_only_for_supported_rows or test_footer_shows_history_for_alias_backed_launch_setting', reproduced in isolation on clean master via git stash. Discovered while running just test-scoped for an unrelated change (restoring Gemini 3.7 Flash High to @xsmall only, plan restore_gemini_xsmall_only.md). Scope: either the models panel footer stopped rendering the History hint for these rows (a real regression, possibly from a recent footer-related commit like bbc24e472 'fix(ace): keep Launch Control footer stable') or the test's expectation is stale; investigate which and fix accordingly.

payload.entry: TRIAGE 2026-08-16 (workspace sase_13, master 630f4ea71). Reproduced exactly as reported -- all three nodes fail on a clean tree. But this is not standalone work: bc529f11f (phase sase-n8.6 of the IN_PROGRESS epic sase-n8) added both these tests and the footer markup, and bbc24e472 (phase sase-n8.7, 'keep Launch Control footer stable') then removed the 6 footer-markup lines on purpose so shared Launch Control PNG goldens would not shift, without updating sase-n8.6's assertions. sase-n8 is still IN_PROGRESS with sase-n8.8/sase-n8.9 open and sase-n8.land assigned, and the restore-vs-relax decision (and any golden refresh) belongs to that epic. Recorded on sase-n8 as a DISCOVERED ISSUE with the full evidence. Refile a new node-specific task with a +1 only if sase-n8 lands and these nodes are still red.

payload.close_reason: Fallout of the still-active epic sase-n8 (its own phase sase-n8.7 removed the hint that its phase sase-n8.6 asserts); routed to sase-n8 as a DISCOVERED ISSUE per the active-epic triage rule.
